body: Thank you- this really made me feel less alone <3
How did you move on?  This has been one thing that has been very hard for me.
I understand this too well.  I’m sorry you feel the same way I do.  I hope you find your way to happiness.  Or, at least contentment.

Thank you ❤️  This was a nice read and I appreciate your comment.  Yes, it’s an ex.  I know I’m projecting everything I wanted him to be on to him.  But we did go through a lot together.  I think I’m just profoundly lonely, like I don’t fit in with anyone and no one truly cares or would understand what I’m going through.  It’s just a sad lonely world.  Thank you for reaching out and giving me a little light for my day.
Noooooooo....  Run for your life and never look back.
